module: Flowgraph node "Context Translation" (category repeat_instant): creates a translation object with context. Input "translationString" (translation key, fixed pin) plus custom input pins (all types except flow): each becomes a context variable. Output "value" (table of type translationObject): {txt = key, context = {name = value}}. The "Load Variables" button in the properties creates a string pin for each {{name}} variable found in the translation.
notes: The translation key is resolved with _tr() to find the {{%a+}} variables (letters only).
drawCustomProperties calls dump('string: ...') on every load (debug trace).
The custom pins are saved (savePins = true).

drawCustomProperties.desc: Displays the variable loading state (red/green/white icon) and the "Load Variables" button that recreates the context pins.

init.desc: Enables savePins and allowCustomInPins; creates the reused output table {context = {}}.

work.desc: Fills txt and context (value of each custom pin) in the reused output table and writes it to "value".
